I am from Kapurthala, one of the 4 cities he mentioned in Doaba region in Panjab, we know about Sartaj, it's a privilege to come from the same area that gave birth to such a gem, we have been listening to him since 2007. He mentions Kapurthala in his song Filhaal, which he was talking about in this episode and it used to make me giggle as a child when the song came out but in actuality the song is so deep and so thought provoking. We're blessed that in a world of Karan Aujlas, Diljits and Moosewalas, we also have a humble sufi musician like Sartaj, I remember Sidhu used to be such a big fan of Sartaj too when he was alive.
